printed_gun.name: Liberator 3D Printed Pistol
printed_gun.shortDescription: A low cost plastic 3D printed pistol.
printed_gun.flavorText: Doesn't get cheaper than this. It's good for a few shots.

handmade_pistol.name: Nestfire Compact
handmade_pistol.shortDescription: A small open-sourced pistol chambered in .22 SR
handmade_pistol.flavorText: Widely used for home defence in the Lower Level. Mostly tolerated by Security. Probably handmade by a Lower Level gunsmith.

heavy_handmade_pistol.name: Ironcraft 10
heavy_handmade_pistol.shortDescription: A heavy open-sourced pistol chambered in 10mm
heavy_handmade_pistol.flavorText: Capable of piercing body armor. A popular weapon for Lower Level Revolutionary.

glock_receiver.name: Sentinel Mk. III.
glock_receiver.shortDescription: A reliable handgun, chambered in 10mm. Mostly carried by Security

smg.name: Peacemaker Heavy SMG
smg.shortDescription: A heavy SMG, chambered in 10mm. Used sparingly by Security during high stakes operations.

shotgun.name: Rampart Dual-Action Shotgun
shotgun.shortDescription: A dependable and adaptable shotgun built for law enforcement, featuring a dual-action mechanism that ensures reliable performance with a wide range of ammunition types.

revolver.name: Lancewell Revolver
revolver.shortDescription: A 5" general purpose Lancewell revolver chambered in .45 AFP.
revolver.flavorText: A simple and highly reliable weapon. Designed to endure extreme conditions, while requiring minimum maintenance.

stun_gun.name: PulseGuard Stun Gun
stun_gun.flavorText: A well made self-defence option officially endorsed by Security. Mostly used by Upper Level due to high cost.

small_pistol_ammo.name: .22 SR Ammunition
small_pistol_ammo.flavorText: A handful of .22 SR ammo. While small, it still can be lethal at close range. Most importantly, it is very cheap.

small_pistol_ammo_p.name: .22 SR Ammunition (AP)
small_pistol_ammo_p.flavorText: A handful of .22 SR Armor-Piercing ammo. Capable of piercing body armor.

small_pistol_ammo_nl.name: .22 SR Ammunition (Non-Lethal)
small_pistol_ammo_nl.flavorText: A handful of .22 SR Non-Lethal ammo. Tip with rubber, it is designed to incapacitate.

heavy_pistol_ammo.name: 10mm Ammunition
heavy_pistol_ammo.flavorText: A handful of 10mm ammo. Powerful and reliable, it is the standard round for heavy pistols.

heavy_pistol_ammo_p.name: 10mm Ammunition (AP)
heavy_pistol_ammo_p.flavorText: A handful of high velocity 10mm Armor-Piercing Discarding Sabot (APDS) ammo. Capable of piercing body armor.

heavy_pistol_ammo_nl.name: 10mm Ammunition (Non-Lethal)
heavy_pistol_ammo_nl.flavorText: A handful of 10mm Non-Lethal ammo. Tip with rubber, it is designed to incapacitate.

tazer.name: Tazer
tazer.flavorText: A compact stun weapon used for self-defense and enforcement. Delivers a painful jolt.

handmade_pistol_frame.name: Nestfire Compact Frame
handmade_pistol_frame.shortDescription: An incomplete gun frame, add a gun part on it to finish it.

heavy_handmade_pistol_frame.name: Ironcraft 10 Frame
heavy_handmade_pistol_frame.shortDescription: An incomplete gun frame, add a gun part on it to finish it.
